snapshot_minus_integral.conclusion: Snapshot minus accumulated activity is not an instantaneous non-active count; this is a continuous-time illustration distinct from the discrete protocol endpoint convention.

service_aliasing.reason: Stationary independent Poisson arrivals with iid marks; service <1 hour makes the marked-arrival sets serving different integer snapshots disjoint. Counts have the same mean lambda E[S].
service_aliasing.scope: Only integer occupancy snapshots, not an equivalence claim after duration observations.

price_equivalence.scope: Unrestricted latent utility shocks; no causal elasticity identification.

rejected_arrivals.assumption: All resources busy throughout interval; arrivals leave without influencing incumbent service; no rejection log observed.
